caption: The drawing depicts three main objects related to a door lock mechanism, rendered in pencil and colored shades of yellow, gold, grey, and black. At the upper section, there is a small, vertically oriented, oval-shaped keyhole plate colored in gold with two visible screws, and a black keyhole slot in the center. Next to it is a circular ring handle, depicted in a golden-yellow hue with metallic shading, attached by a small round mount. The largest object at the bottom is a rectangular surface-mounted box lock colored in gold with black and grey outlining for shadows and contours. The box lock features a matching circular ring handle on its face, identical in style to the one above, and is secured by two visible screws at the corners, with part of the locking bolt and a compatible strike plate shown to the right. The drawing includes a simple linear scale in inches at the bottom right and is framed by a single line border, with the name "J. STALOFF" inscribed at the lower left.
title: Lock Handle and Key Plate
